patterns.note: Asymmetrical section layouts with floating, playful illustrations and graphic elements that break out of content boundaries, creating a dynamic and less rigid feel.
A strong contrast between oversized, bold, and often uppercase display headings and a more legible, smaller body text, creating clear hierarchy and a distinct brand voice.
Alternating background colors between a warm light beige and a deep forest green, punctuated by a vibrant orange for accents and calls to action.

A top banner with event information appears and sticks to the top of the viewport after initial scroll, while the main page background color transitions from light beige to dark green. Floating graphic elements move with a subtle parallax effect or reveal/disappear as the user scrolls, and a large stylized logo reveals from the bottom of the page.
Sections are often introduced by large, impactful headings and feature a mix of polaroid-style image collages and bulleted lists, maintaining a casual yet informative tone.

technique_notes: To rebuild the motion, implement a sticky header that appears after a certain scroll threshold. Use a scroll-triggered animation to transition the main background color of the page. Floating graphic elements should be positioned absolutely and animated with a subtle parallax effect or fade-in/out based on scroll depth. A large, stylized logo at the bottom of the page should be revealed with a scroll-triggered fade-in or slide-up animation as it enters the viewport.
Create a distinct brand identity by combining a custom, playful display font for key branding elements with a clean, bold sans-serif for headings and a readable sans-serif for body text.

Design sections with a primary content block (text or images) and then scatter illustrative graphic elements around it, allowing them to overlap or extend beyond the main content area to create visual interest.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold, and often uppercase display headings (~3-5x body) create strong visual anchors, contrasted with smaller, highly legible body text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners are used for buttons and image frames, giving a soft but not overly rounded character.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy spacing is used throughout, with generous vertical padding between sections and comfortable line spacing for text, contributing to an open and inviting feel.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its playful, retro-inspired illustrations and custom, bold typography that create a strong, memorable brand personality. The dynamic background color transition and the way graphic elements float and interact with the scroll add an engaging, interactive layer that feels unique and energetic.
